notes.title: Event update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

As GM_Casper was away yesterday, he wasn't able to run the Blind Man's Bluff yesterday as was scheduled. Casper should be in tomorrow and should be able to run a rescheduled event. We apologize for the inconvenience and the confusion.

notes.title: December 22nd: Item Mall Update - DECK THE HALLS EDITION
notes.notes:
Santa has come bearing gifts once again to the Item Mall! Today, you can pick up a very special costume set that may just give you a ride-able Rudolph, Prancer, Dancer, or Vixen of your own! As well, we have released a very special Pet Gachapon that has a chance to get one of several pets! Enjoy and Happy Holidays!

December Pet Gachapon - High chance to get one of the following pets:

Wood Contract - Misty
Ice Contract - Miyu
Time Contract - Ofulian
Spiritual Bond - Leah
Spiritual Bond - Milo
Gem Contract - Mechant Joena
Metal Contract - Minerva
Medical Contract - Nurse Yuna
Chalice Contract - Priestess Valerie
Dessert Contract - Princess Cosette

Cosmetics:

Christmas Dress +

Christmas Deer Hat +
Christmas Gentleman Suit +

Rudolph's Red Nose

notes.title: Maintenance has concluded + Patch notes
notes.notes:
Maintenance has concluded and we have a major item mall update as well as a couple of fixes. Please view the patch notes below:
-SE8 Pets are now live!
-Ancient male and female permanent costume boxes are now available. Box details will be posted on the forums later today.
-Over 80 costume pieces have been added including mech suits and wings.
-Skill scrolls are now LIVE! (Warning: Careful when using the scrolls as they increase the skill you want to increase by one level. Level up the skill a few times first before applying.)
-Spellpower Scrolls and Scrapper's Scroll VI are added to Stat Boosters tab.
-Cherry Blossom Hair Dye has now been added to Item Mall
-Reincarnation fee is now 1,000,000 and won't take anymore gold than it says.

NOTE: The Costume Mod NPC is NOT available yet. We noticed that the Premium Silk leaked through and had immediately taken it down. We won't penalize anyone for using it before the system is ready. However if we make any changes to the costume modding system before the official release, there might be unprecedented changes to your modded costumes that we can not provide any support for. If you have any in possession, please use at your own risk.

notes.title: March 14th Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
We got a patch in yesterday, and it was a doozy of a text update. Now a lot more stuff in the game will make sense!

    1196 skill text fixes
    264 system message fixes
    339 scene name and scene transition fixes
    852 schematic text fixes
    64 consumable text fixes
    60 Class and crafting text fixes.
    140 UI text fixes
    816 item effect text fixes
    56 NPC name fixes
    48 battle map marker fixes
    172 item mall description fixes
    100 tutorial text fixes

More detailed descriptions of the patch notes, and what specific quests are fixed, can be found here! 

Also, as of the patch previous to this one, the Joan of Arc and Hattori Hanzo battlepets function properly when summoning or opening the contract.

Enjoy!
